purpose: Static MST-source candidate discovery only; numeric or literal matches are not implementation proof.

registers.name: DP_DPCD_REV
registers.role: Base receiver revision; not MST by itself

registers.name: DP_GUID
registers.role: Branch GUID; correlate with route and ports

registers.name: DP_MSTM_CTRL
registers.role: MST source and upstream-request enable bits

registers.name: DP_PAYLOAD_ALLOCATE_SET
registers.role: Payload ID, starting slot and slot count in three adjacent bytes

registers.name: DP_SINK_COUNT
registers.role: Sink count alone does not establish MST

registers.name: DP_PAYLOAD_TABLE_UPDATE_STATUS
registers.role: Payload update acknowledgement and ACT handling

registers.name: DP_SET_POWER
registers.role: DP power control; not MST by itself

registers.name: DP_DEVICE_SERVICE_IRQ_VECTOR_ESI0
registers.role: ESI IRQ vector including message-ready bits

opcodes.name: DP_LINK_ADDRESS
opcodes.role: Enumerate branch GUID and port list

opcodes.name: DP_ALLOCATE_PAYLOAD
opcodes.role: Port, stream count, VCPI, big-endian PBN and SDP stream-sink nibbles

opcodes.name: DP_REMOTE_DPCD_READ
opcodes.role: Routed port plus 20-bit DPCD address and byte count

opcodes.name: DP_REMOTE_DPCD_WRITE
opcodes.role: Routed port plus 20-bit DPCD address, byte count and data

opcodes.name: DP_REMOTE_I2C_READ
opcodes.role: Routed I2C transactions followed by read device/count

opcodes.name: DP_QUERY_STREAM_ENC_STATUS
opcodes.role: Stream encryption status; not a stream encoder/packetizer by itself

codec.header_bytes: 3 + floor(LCT/2), not sizeof a C struct

crc.note: Linux function name drm_dp_msg_data_crc4 computes an 8-bit body remainder; do not infer width from its name.

codec.topology: Branch GUID, RAD nibbles, LCT, parent port, port list, input/output flags, downstream state, full/available PBN, remote EDID context
state_transitions: send downstream request or upstream reply window
dispatch ACK/NAK and known request ID

payload.pbn_formula: ceil((clock_kHz * bpp_x16) * ((64 * overhead) >> 4) / (1000000 * 8 * 54 * 1000)); current DRM overhead helper includes MST and SSC terms
state_transitions: calculate mode PBN and per-slot bandwidth
reserve VCPI and contiguous time slots for a stream on its primary DP link
program source stream/transcoder payload allocation and emit ACT
observe ACT sent and branch ACT handled
payload.packetizer_discriminator: Multiple independent stream encoders share a primary DP port/link and map each stream to payload/slot state. Separate DP tunnels or encryption stream IDs alone do not satisfy this.

constant_groups.assessment: Require actual DP-address flow or codec, not allocation sizes
Require payload ID/start/count or ACT status flow, not member offsets
Require MST bit/routing semantics; small constants are common
Require nibble/byte polynomial loop and MST header fields
Require request-ID dispatch and PBN/payload structure
Non-MST DP address-use control, still requires argument/data flow

literal_patterns.assessment: Include mangled/CamelCase names; reject unrelated acronyms and generic multi-stream media
Require DisplayPort attribution; Thunderbolt sideband/virtual channels are negative controls
Weak alone; disambiguate branches, radio, active/action and transport-independent topology

limits: No numeric hit alone proves a register access
No literal alone proves a reachable M5 implementation
No host-side negative proves firmware or hardware absence
No retired selector transport may be reopened or executed
